system.description:
• Frame (1st): your blast is your weapon. Hit Die d4.
  • Signature Sculpt (1st): Honed Blast: your Eldritch Blast, plain or signature, adds your Charisma modifier to damage. Once per encounter your signature blast costs no Patron Favour.
  • Free invocations (1st): one Shape and one Mark.
  • Twin Bolt (7th): your plain blast can target two creatures, each saving on its own. A Shape replaces it.
  • Sculpted Space (9th): your signature blast can carry two Marks (each creature makes one save for both). You can take Burst and Chain at any level, and you choose creatures in a Burst or Lance to spare.
  • 15th: your signature blast costs no Patron Favour twice an encounter.
  • Pact spells: Shield, Spiritual Weapon, Gust of Wind, Evard's Black Tentacles, Wall of Force, Disintegrate.
